headline: Fronts Erupt as Bases Change Hands Across War
war_summary: Since the 15:22 edition the fighting has intensified on several fronts. Godcrofts has exploded with seventy‑two ownership changes in the past day, the highest turnover on the map, while Fishermans Row continues its relentless churn with thirty‑nine flips in twenty‑four hours and heavy losses on both sides. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theatre, adding roughly one‑thousand Colonial and twelve‑hundred Warden casualties per two‑hour window, though its base‑flip pace has eased to seven in the last six hours. Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle each recorded fresh activity — four and five flips respectively in the last two hours — pushing their daily totals to thirty‑two and twenty‑eight. Farranac Coast, previously quiet, now shows five flips in two hours and eight in twenty‑four, accompanied by rising attrition. DeadLands logged three flips in the last two hours, the only other sector with recent ownership changes. All other regions reported no base transitions, though enlistments continue to climb across the board.
